label: heartbeat
schema:
CREATE TABLE _cf_KV (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value BLOB
      ) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE "d1_migrations"(
		id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		name       TEXT UNIQUE,
		applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE heartbeat_log (
  batch_index    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   
  device_id      TEXT NOT NULL,         
  leaf_hashes    TEXT NOT NULL,         
  batch_root     TEXT NOT NULL,         
  prev_root      TEXT NOT NULL,         
  entry_count    INTEGER NOT NULL,      
  client_batch_id TEXT UNIQUE,         
  ts             TEXT NOT NULL          
)

CREATE INDEX idx_heartbeat_device_ts
  ON heartbeat_log(device_id, ts)

CREATE TABLE heartbeat_points (
  batch_index INTEGER NOT NULL,   
  point_index INTEGER NOT NULL,   
  device_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  ts          TEXT NOT NULL,      
  lat         REAL NOT NULL,
  lon         REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (batch_index, point_index)
)

CREATE INDEX idx_points_device_ts
  ON heartbeat_points(device_id, ts)

CREATE TABLE gps_points (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, ride_id TEXT, ts TEXT NOT NULL, lat REAL NOT NULL, lon REAL NOT NULL, acc REAL, speed REAL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, received_at TEXT NOT NULL, drained INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
